verdict.rationale: Gecko's docs promise AI-driven triage: each finding ships with a confidence score, severity, call chain and PoC (explaining the finding), and connecting an AI tool via its MCP/API lets that tool 'triage findings' and file tickets (docs-2, docs-9, docs-10). However, hands-on community reports directly contradict the reliability of this triage: the tool gave 100% confidence to two vulnerabilities that turned out to be false positives, and other scans surfaced trivial/irrelevant findings while missing a real known issue (comm-3, comm-4, comm-5), undermining the 'flagging likely false positives' promise. Missing for 10: no deduplication feature is documented at all, and no evidence rebuts the false-positive/confidence-score failures reported by users.
